entities.summary: Gwanda is a town in Zimbabwe. It is the capital of the province of Matabeleland South, one of the ten administrative provinces in the country. It is also the district capital of Gwanda District, one of the seven administrative districts in the province. Gwanda is a city in East Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
